name: sg_mail_sends_list
description: Filter all messages sent through the mail send log to search recent email activity. (GET /v3/messages)

to_email.description: Filter messages by the intended recipient's email address.

status.description: Filter messages by status: processed, delivered, bounced, blocked, or dropped.

template_id.description: Filter messages by the email template ID used for the send.

limit.description: The number of messages returned. Defaults to 30.
